name: Raidlands
description:
Welcome to Raid Lands, in the server you must protect your base to prevent players from raiding and destroying your base. Our server features nostalgic terrain from older versions of Minecraft which is in many different zones. We also have a friendly community which can help you out and become a team member of your base!

We also feature ranks that players can earn by playing the server for a certain period of time, and the higher ranks having perks such as a different text color in the chat, can claim more plots in creative and claim more land in survival.

The server features sub-servers which include Creative Plots which is a separate server in Raid Lands where you can build your future base plans and share it with the community peace of mind without the risk of being raided. We feature a Survival server which has no raiding, land claims and features terrain from Alpha 1.1 throughout the world and has an economy where you can build and upgrade spawners to earn money from the drops from your farms.

We also feature an Event server where special events are hosted by us. The events have Parkour, Spleef, PvP, and more. The event server also has Parkour in the Event Hub which you can play any time, even when no events are running. Winning an event will award you a special suffix in chat and more!

Terrain version zones:

- Until 616 blocks in any direction: Beta 1.7 terrain

- Until 1320 blocks in any direction: 1.6 terrain

- Until 2776 blocks in any direction: 1.12 terrain

- After 2776 blocks in any direction: Modern terrain

* Bedrock clients now supported *

Supported versions: 1.9.x - 1.21.x

Java & Bedrock IP: raidlands.org

Creative Plots Map: https://plotsmap.raidlands.org

Survival Map: https://survivalmap.raidlands.org

Community Discord: discord.gg/KdSeAD3
